load_frame_tagger: load a Wav2Vec2 frame classification model from a pretrained checkpoint for emphasis prediction
predict_emphasis: predict frame-level emphasis scores for an audio waveform and project them onto utterance words
evaluate_emphasis_alignment: compute emphasis recall and precision metrics between source and target utterances using word alignments
compute_alignment_recall: compute the weighted proportion of alignment edges from source words that map to target words
review_emphasis_detection: review the emphasis detection module to understand frame-level prediction and alignment evaluation logic
